pos.personaBrief: Hudl says Flamengo dominates possession but is direct, not a long-possession side, and scores from counters; Jesus wants the ball and says the team always looks forward. Possession is a tool for controlling and attacking.

pro.personaBrief: Short goal-kick build-up with Arao dropping between centre-backs (Hudl), yet fast vertical passes and a game 'always looking forward' (Jesus, Dec 2019) and quick counters.

est.personaBrief: Rehearsed automatisms with defined phases, but mobile front pair with total mobility and wingers free to move inside (Hudl); full-backs act as wingers.

lar.personaBrief: Filipe Luis and Rafinha occupy the flanks as coordinating wingers (Hudl), while the 4-4-2 wingers come inside and Diego/Arrascaeta distribute; width comes from full-backs, main talent central.

blo.personaBrief: Very close lines, intensive approach, strikers active in pressing, immediate counter-press after losing the ball (Hudl); Jesus asked for pressure intensity.

mar.personaBrief: Hudl: zonal marking in the sector with some short pursuits; no evidence of dedicated man-marking of stars.

pla.personaBrief: Jesus brought his model ready, 'procuramos ser iguais a nos proprios', refused to sit back against Liverpool, though he speaks of variations and many ideas.

res.personaBrief: Jesus: Europeans are trained to win and give spectacle; offensive posture even in the Club World Cup final against Liverpool.

sis.personaBrief: Strong collective system with defined roles and pressing duties for all, but built around skilled forwards and playmakers like Gabigol, Arrascaeta, Diego.

jog.personaBrief: Technical squad (Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro, Diego) with high intensity demands; ball-playing midfielders like Arao and Gerson.

bas.personaBrief: Squad built through expensive experienced signings, Jesus agreed on positions to buy; focus on winning titles, veterans like Rafinha, Filipe Luis, Diego.

lid.personaBrief: Jesus created a regulation equal for all, fines himself double, uses the captain to transmit his ideas; strong authority, stars follow rules.
